notes: Training labels remain resolved first-passage labels because supervised fitting requires an observed target.
Calibration and validation signal generation use every eligible causal stride anchor, not only anchors that later resolved into a stored label.
This removes future-resolvability selection from the economic signal universe.
The latest stored UTC date is excluded by default to avoid scoring a partial trading day.
The 2026-09-23 v1 result was observed before this v2 protocol was written, so v2 scoring of 2026-09-23 is a diagnostic cross-check rather than a pristine v2 forward day.
The first pristine v2 forward day is strictly after 2026-09-23.
This protocol never authorizes demo or live execution by itself.
